name: Question 7
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,X\,$ | $\,Y\,$ | $\,(X∨Y)⇒(X∧Y)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add columns for $X∨Y$ and $X∧Y:$

| $\,X\,$ | $\,Y\,$ | $\,X∨Y\,$ | $\,X∧Y\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Now, we add a column for $(X∨Y)⇒(X∧Y).$ This statement is true unless $X∨Y$ is true and $X∧Y$ is false.

| $\,X\,$ | $\,Y\,$ | $\,X∨Y\,$ | $\,X∧Y\,$ | $\,(X∨Y)⇒(X∧Y)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
